instruction: Create a PDF version of the OIP.jpg receipt image located in /home/user, saving it as 'receipt.pdf' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task converts image to PDF. Evaluator validates: (1) PDF is valid with pages (0.3), (2) PDF contains at least 1 embedded image (0.7). For image-to-PDF conversion, the resulting PDF should contain the original image as embedded content, so min_images=1 is correct.

scoring_breakdown.0.3: PDF is valid and has at least one page
scoring_breakdown.1.0: PDF contains at least 1 embedded image

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirements
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly retrieves the PDF from the expected location (/home/user/Desktop/receipt.pdf)
Metric (check_pdf_image_count__f35ebb0d) properly validates: (1) PDF is valid with pages (0.3 points), (2) PDF contains at least 1 embedded image (0.7 points)
